svg.title: Starlight Tracer · 100 unique smooth path shapes
svg.desc: A ten by ten reference sheet showing all one hundred unique Starlight Tracer paths. It contains sixty wave paths and forty spirals with one to ten turns. Every path is a continuous sequence of smooth cubic curves.
svg.text: 100 unique continuous curves · 60 waves with varied amplitude and spacing · 40 spirals from 1 to 10 turns
